'''Juno''' is a young girl NPC found at the [[Order of the Deep (Area)|Order of the Deep]] with Acolyte [[Alice]]. At night, she is caught by her father, '''Molvan''', for wandering the garden and digging up a treasure left behind by [[Phoebe]]. Afterwards, she no longer wanders at night and her father strictly watches her during the day nearby.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;(Day)
:'''Juno:''' Alice, when will Phoebe bring the Echoes back here?
:'''Juno:''' Since she and the Echoes left, even the little  sea anemones here have been looking a bit droopy.
:'''Alice:''' Phoebe?
:'''Juno:''' Yeah! Every time Phoebe comes here, she tells us new stories.
:'''Juno:''' Our elders always say the other side is dangerous, full of bad people. But the new stories Phoebe brings back are always exciting!
:'''Juno:''' Whenever she tells us a story, a bunch of Echoes would join in and perform with her, like a little play—it's incredible!
:'''Juno:''' I haven't seen her in ages... Do you know when she'll come back?
:'''Alice:''' I'll pass your message on to her. Knowing her, I'm sure she'll come as soon as she has a moment.
:'''Juno:''' Really? That's wonderful!
----
;<nowiki>17:00-05:59</nowiki>, Juno starts wandering around the garden.
:'''Juno:''' Little Sea Anemone's first outing... it's a bit nerve wracking.
:'''Juno:''' Oh, right! Sister Phoebe gave me a little gift, and said she hid it in the garden!
:'''Juno:''' Where could it be... could it be here?
:'''Juno:''' Damn! It's a telescope! That's amazing! Now I can see the bustling Ragunna!
:'''Juno:''' Maybe I'll even spot Little Sea Anemone and Sister Phoebe!
----
;Following morning, Juno is being interrogated by her father.
:'''Molvan:''' Juno, hold out your hand.
:'''Juno:''' Father... I...
:'''Molvan:''' A telescope? Who gave this to you?
:'''Juno:''' ...
:'''Molvan:''' That little Acolyte with a group of Echoes again?
:'''Juno:''' No... no! I... I found it... on my own...
:'''Molvan:''' Did she teach you to lie like this?
:'''Juno:''' I...
{{Dialogue End}}
